thread:
Priya: Quick follow-up from last night's outage — want to land a super-light action tracking template + an IC rotation plan so followups don't stall.
Sam: +1. keep it tiny. most followups die because they're too heavy.
Chris: Agree. also tag actions as customer-facing vs internal.
Priya: Minimal fields: Action, Owner, Priority (P0/P1/P2), Due, Verification criteria, Blockers. Cadence: 48h quick check, then weekly pulse until closed.
Tess: Comms: 24h short status (done/blocked), +72h summary in #incidents and note in customer doc if external.
Priya: Copy-paste template to use in followups/postmortems:
```
Action: one-line remediation
Owner: full name (pager if needed)
Priority: P0/P1/P2
Due: YYYY-MM-DD or TBD
Verification: how we'll validate (link)
Blockers: short note
Rollback: optional rollback criteria
Release: release/deploy containing fix (if relevant)
Cost/Impact: rough p99/latency/cost impact
```
Sam: Add "Rollback criteria" please — saves time during rollouts. :thinking_face:
Priya: Added.
Chris: Ownership lifecycle: owner must ack within 24h and weekly owner pulse until Closed. Automate reminders.
Jordan: I can own the IC rotation calendar and OpsBot reminders. Propose 2-week IC rotation with a 30m handoff slot (IC checklist: active incidents, open remediations, exec comms).
Tess: Handovers = 10 bullet points max: what's critical, who to call, where logs/dashboards live.
Priya: For recurring patterns: at first follow-up do a 5-min "recurrence triage" — if same symptom 2x in 30 days, flag to recurring-incidents board and open a small investigation spike.
Sam: Surface recurring flags in the incident list UI and weekly infra review.
Chris: Also tag cost-regression for token/CPU spend; helps prioritize low-effort high-impact work.
Jordan: I'll wire OpsBot to create the Jira ticket when someone pastes the template and sets Owner: — it'll create project=INCIDENTS, label=incident-<id>, and ping the owner.
Priya: Next steps: Jordan sets rotation calendar + OpsBot reminders; Sam drafts one-page timeline template for writeups and posts by EOD; I'll schedule 30min review Friday 10:00 to validate owners.
Tess: I'll add verification metric examples.
Sam: I'll include an example timeline snippet (events + latency/cost at each step) so teams know expected granularity.
Chris: Note: prefer a named person as owner; if team-owned, require a nominated point person.
Priya: Agreed.
Jordan: OpsBot: reminder scheduled to post "create jira tasks from followup template" in 24h.
OpsBot: Reminder set — will post in #incidents in 24h and DM owners.
Tess: :thumbsup: this feels actionable and lightweight.
Priya: I'll capture decisions in the followup doc and link to the postmortem.
